title: Health report format, version 1
description: What a service serves so that a health endpoint monitor can show its state, the rules that decided it, and the evidence. See health-format.md for how each field is read.

healthReport.description: Format version. Also how the document is recognised.

message.description: One line saying what is wrong. The first 200 characters are shown.

service.description: Which service wrote this. The first 60 characters are shown.

version.description: The running build. The first 40 characters are shown.

environment.description: production, staging, and so on. The first 40 characters are shown.

components.description: The parts that make up the verdict, in display order. The first 50 are shown.

status.description: up, degraded or down. Readers also accept ok, pass, healthy, warn, warning, fail, error and unhealthy in any case; this schema accepts only the canonical three so that new endpoints use them.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 date and time with an offset, for example 2026-10-09T14:02:11Z.

id.description: Stable identifier. Never change it once shipped.

name.description: Display name, defaults to id. The first 60 characters are shown.

message.description: What is wrong with this part, or a short reading. The first 200 characters are shown.

unit.description: Printed after value. The first 16 characters are shown.

durationMs.description: How long this part's own check took.

conditions.description: The rules that decided this part's status. The first 20 are shown.

log.description: What happened, newest last. The first 50 are shown.

name.description: Display name, defaults to id. The first 60 characters are shown.

observed.description: What was measured. Strings are cut to 80 characters.

rule.description: The threshold, in words. The first 80 characters are shown.

unit.description: Printed after observed. The first 16 characters are shown.

window.description: The span the measurement covers, such as 5m. The first 16 characters are shown.

data.description: Flat key and value pairs. The first 20 keys are shown; strings are cut to 200 characters.
